Two stages. Two sounds. ONE war zone of bass 🔥⚡ Lollipop Raves & Supera are back with Techno vs House Part II and this time it's bigger — 10 DJs battling all night long. Pick a side or run between both: Techno stage bringing the dark, driving energy with Connie B, Cuddi, Nightpeak, Goteq, and Clout — while the House stage keeps it groovy with Daisytrrip, Chase Björnson, Baydhabitz, Sartonix, and Gioboomin closing it out. Full bar all night, live tattoo art from Amor y Arte going down while the speakers shake the walls. This isn't a party you ease into — it's one you pick a team for. Presale is $15 and it WILL move fast off the last round.

Friday, August 7th • 9PM–2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15 presale
🔞 21+

Feel the split before you even walk in 🔴🟣 One side pulses red — dark, relentless, techno running through the floor. The other glows purple — smooth, hypnotic, house rhythms pulling you into the crowd. Two stages standing back to back at Azucar, sound bleeding across the room while the needle buzzes from Amor y Arte's tattoo station and the bar keeps the night loose. This is Techno vs House Part II — the kind of night where you feel torn between stages till 2AM because both sides are calling your name. Ten DJs, one dance floor, zero reason to sit still.

No sides picked here, just people who came to move 💃🕺 Techno vs House Part II is for everybody who's ever stood between two speakers and couldn't decide which one hit harder. Come as your loudest, your most yourself — the floor doesn't care which stage you love more. Lollipop Raves & Supera built this night for the whole Tri-Cities community to link up, dance it out, and maybe walk away with fresh ink from Amor y Arte as proof you were there. Bring your people, bring your energy, leave the rest at the door.
